source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 4638 moves 18 header sources from public to src and updates their path guards. The build lists still export their basenames; MimeEncoder.h and MimeHeaderParser.h retain the mozilla.mailnews export namespace. Component registration also follows the new source paths. A src location alone therefore does not establish that these headers are private to one implementation. This claim is limited to the inspected export and registration entries. The move preserves all original non-guard header bytes; accepted whole headers later differ. No build or ABI validation ran.
title: The relocated MailNews headers remain in the build export lists
